agency.name: Behavioral Health Administration (BHA), Maryland Department of Health

countyDirectory.name: Maryland Association of Behavioral Health Authorities (MABHA) — county Local Behavioral Health Authorities

narrNote: Maryland does NOT appear on NARR's official affiliate list. Maryland instead runs its own state certification — the Maryland Certification of Recovery Residences (MCORR) — administered through BHA.
notes: Medicaid SUD services (including IMD residential) are authorized under the Maryland HealthChoice 1115 demonstration, per CMS's official SUD demonstration listing (linked). Maryland Medicaid's behavioral-health ASO changed from Optum Maryland to Carelon Behavioral Health effective Jan 1, 2025. The Maryland Crisis Hotline (1-800-422-0009) is the state's long-standing 24/7 crisis line; Marylanders can also reach crisis help via 988 or by calling 211 and pressing 1. BHA phone per the official Maryland Manual. BHA's own CSA/LBHA resource page rendered without body content in text fetch, so the verified MABHA site (the county LBHAs' association) is used for the county-authority layer. BACKFILL 2026-10-22: the former BHA SharePoint homepage (health.maryland.gov/bha/Pages/Home.aspx) returned 404; BHA's website now runs on its own subdomain, so agency.url — and stateCrisis.url, which pointed at the same dead page — now use the current BHA homepage (bha.health.maryland.gov/pages/index.aspx), fetch-verified live on 2026-10-22 ('Behavioral Health Administration Home' — BHA, as part of the Maryland Department of Health, oversees inpatient and community behavioral health services for Marylanders with mental health and substance use disorders).
